events.title: Cactus Flats Demo — Update 0.1.1
events.summary: Howdy, folks!Update 0.1.1 is now available for the Cactus Flats demo!Fixes • Fixed controller issues in the shop menu. • Fixed controller issues with the hotbar. • Fixed a pathfinding bug during the boss battle.Improvements • Added the ability to resize the game window on macOS. • Added a button to join the Cactus Flats Discord community.Thanks for playing! If you run into any issues, please let me know in the Steam discussions or on Discord. Your feedback helps me keep improving the game.— Grap

events.title: Update Notes - macOS Support Added
events.summary: Hello everyone,Today’s update brings macOS support to Cactus Flats on Steam.Update NotesAdded macOS build supportMac players can now access the game through SteamOngoing improvements and development continueThis is a big step forward for the project, and I’m excited to make the game available to more players.If you try the macOS build, I’d love to hear how it performs and if you run into any issues. Your feedback helps a lot as development continues.Thank you for your support.– Grape Soda Games

events.title: The Cactus Flats Demo is Now Available
events.summary: The Cactus Flats demo is now live on Steam.Step into the frontier and try the opening slice of the game for yourself.
